scope: SOUTH wave — District 7 / Phú Mỹ Hưng, Nhà Bè, deeper District 4

creators.name: Will Fly for Food (JB & Renée Macatulad)
creators.verifiable: Long-running, widely-cited travel-food publication with a real, findable track record and a dedicated on-the-ground Vĩnh Khánh (District 4) street-seafood article. No follower count asserted (not verified); used as a credible established blogger, paired with Rusty Compass.

note: No VN TikToker/YouTuber cleared the verifiable-following bar for a specific NEW place this wave. Korea Town (D7) is heavily covered by Korean-language personal blogs (hochiminhgourmet.com, vietnamtraveler.wixsite.com) and by SEO listicles (mytour, vietpowertravel, vinpearl/vinwonders, viet-go, gtrip) — none of which are verifiable popular creators, so none were used. Follower numbers were deliberately NOT fabricated for anyone.
